Bring an existing evidence store up to date with Zotero

Source: R/store.R
crd_store_update.Rd

Resolves sources exactly as crd_store_build() does, then changes only what differs: PDFs new to the store are ingested, PDFs whose bytes changed are ingested again, and documents whose source no longer resolves (an item trashed, an attachment replaced, a member taken out of the collection) are removed. Everything else is kept as it is, without being read or embedded again. The result holds the documents a fresh build from the same arguments would hold, at the cost of the changes alone.

Usage

crd_store_update(
  store_path,
  collection = NULL,
  citation_keys = NULL,
  zotero_dir = "~/Zotero",
  library = getOption("cred.zotero_library")
)

Arguments

store_path

character(1) path to an existing .duckdb store.

collection

character(1) Zotero collection name, or a parent/child path when the name alone matches more than one. Supply exactly one of collection or citation_keys.

citation_keys

character vector of Better BibTeX citation keys.

zotero_dir

character(1) Zotero data directory. Default "~/Zotero".

library

The Zotero library to resolve keys in: "user" for My Library, or a group's name or groupID (as in its URL, zotero.org/groups/<groupID>). Zotero's internal libraryID is not accepted: it differs between machines. Default getOption("cred.zotero_library"); NULL searches every library.

Value

Invisibly, a tibble with one row per resolved file the store now holds (citation_key, src_path), as crd_store_build() returns. Prints how many documents were added, replaced, removed and kept.

Details

How a document is matched. A store records each document by the path its PDF had on the machine that built it. A file Zotero holds is matched by its storage/<attachment key>/<file name> instead, so a store built on a machine whose Zotero data directory is elsewhere updates cleanly. A linked file is matched by its whole path, so it is read again on a machine where it lies elsewhere, and so is an attachment whose file Zotero renamed.

How a changed file is seen. crd_store_build() and this function record each ingested file's md5 in the store. A stored file with no record, as in every store built before stores carried one, is recorded as it is now, and the update says so, because a change made to it before then cannot be seen. A changed file that can no longer be read loses its document, as a build would leave it out, and is tried again by the next update.

What is kept that a build would leave out. A PDF that resolves in Zotero but cannot be read on this machine, because it is not there or not readable, keeps its stored document, and is named. A partly synced Zotero storage/ directory would otherwise strip the store of every file it has not downloaded.

What it embeds with. The store's own recorded embedder, which is the one crd_store_build() pinned, so there is no model argument. Before anything is ingested that embedder is probed: an embedding service that does not answer, or a model that now returns a different width than the store holds, stops the update.

What a failure costs. The update works on a copy beside the store and replaces the store with it only when it has finished. An update that stops part way, for whatever reason, leaves the store exactly as it was, and so does one that would leave it with no documents. When the update would ingest nothing, drop nothing and record nothing new, the store is not written at all, so a new PDF that cannot be read does not rewrite it. Close any connection to the store before updating it.

After an update. The store's md5 no longer matches the manifest, so crd_store_connect() would replace it with the copy the manifest describes. Push it with crd_store_push(), or open it with crd_store_connect(verify = FALSE) until then.

See also

crd_store_build() to build a store from scratch.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
crd_store_build("data/rag/vca_refs.duckdb", collection = "vca",
                library = "NewGraphEnvironment")
# ... a paper is added to the collection in Zotero, another is trashed ...
crd_store_update("data/rag/vca_refs.duckdb", collection = "vca",
                 library = "NewGraphEnvironment")
} # }
